candidates.title: Uncovering the hidden threat: single-organoid analysis reveals clinically relevant treatment-resistant and invasive subclones in pancreatic cancer
candidates.why: PDAC patient-derived organoids treated in culture with gemcitabine plus paclitaxel (Gem-Pac). The untreated baseline samples come from the same three organoid lines (PDAC002, PDAC044, PDAC060).
candidates.case_hint: Gem-Pac 400:80 nM treated organoids from PDAC002, PDAC044 and PDAC060 (7 samples).
candidates.control_hint: Untreated baseline organoids from the same three lines, PDAC002, PDAC044 and PDAC060 (9 samples).
concerns: The design is paired by organoid line; the patient (cell line) should be modelled as a covariate.
Baseline samples from the other five organoid lines are left out because those lines have no treated counterpart.

candidates.title: Triptolide analogs induced apoptosis on pancreatic cancer patient-derived organoids
candidates.why: Two pancreatic cancer patient-derived organoid lines (U049MAI, U123M15-T) cultured with the triptolide analog CK21 or left untreated (No Rx), each at 3, 6, 9 and 12 h. The 12 h time point shows the strongest transcriptional response.
candidates.case_hint: CK21-treated organoids at 12 h (4 samples: 2 lines × 2 replicates).
candidates.control_hint: Untreated (No Rx) organoids at 12 h (4 samples).
concerns: Only 2 organoid lines with 2 replicates each per time point.
The 3–9 h samples are listed as unclear; the authors report fewer than 10 DEGs at 3 h.
The genotype field says WT for all samples.
